messages:
Claire Ho: Opening a small PR to reconcile examples for tiered quota checks and the new dashboard metric ID. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712
Mauro Pacheco: Thanks. Can we include a minimal YAML config example showing client-side routing by quota tier? customers like copy-paste.
Claire Ho: Draft YAML (very small):
```
routing:
  starter: gpt-small
  scale: gpt-medium
```
Renee Li: Add a one-line note explaining `X-Quota-Tier` header values and a short curl example to surface it. Keep it OS-agnostic (avoid jq).
Claire Ho: Curl example: `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate | grep -i X-Quota-Tier`
Mauro Pacheco: Also update the dashboard link in the doc to the new ID: console.redwood.ai/dash/consumption?panelId=22 -> panelId=37. I pushed new screenshots to the branch.
DocsBot: PR 712 created by Claire Ho — CI: docs-build passed ✅ — Preview: https://deploy-preview-712--docs.redwood.ai
Renee Li: QA checklist: verify header names with eng-runtime, confirm screenshots render, add changelog `docs: unify quota examples (YAML + curl)`.
